# Manual transcription data / 人工转写原始数据（CC0 1.0）
# 格式 Format: [<part>] 段；每行 "<小节>: <token> …"；token = <小节内起点>:<音名><八度>/<时值>
#   起点与时值以四分音符为 1（quarter note = 1）；音名为实际音高拼写（G# = G♯，F = F♮）。
#   原谱拍号：Canto、Basso 印 C，鲁特琴谱印 ¢（统一按 4/2 记）：每小节 8 个四分音符；第 23 小节 12 个四分音符（6/2）。
#   原印本音值不缩减：breve = 8，semibreve = 4，minim = 2，crotchet = 1，quaver = 0.5。
#   "!note <part> <小节> <文字>" = 在该处加文字标注。
# 修正不要改本文件，写进同目录 corrections.txt，再运行 python tools/export.py 重新导出。
# Do not edit this file for fixes; add them to corrections.txt and re-run tools/export.py.
# 底本 Source: John Dowland, The Second Booke of Songs or Ayres, London: Thomas Este for George Eastland, 1600,
#   song II "Lachrimæ" (Boston Public Library G.400.52, Internet Archive secondbookeofson00dowl),
#   scans/dowland-lachrimae/secondbookeofson00dowl_n13.jpg (CANTO + lute tablature, 5 systems) and _n14.jpg
#   (BASSO printed rotated 90°, plus the last CANTO/lute system at the foot of the page).
# 声部 Parts: canto = CANTO（原谱 C1 谱号）；basso = BASSO（F4 谱号）；lute = 鲁特琴法式指法谱译成的实际音高
#   (French tablature decoded to sounding pitch; simultaneous letters = several tokens with the same onset).
#   只转写音符；歌词（三段）与指法点不转写 (lyrics and right-hand fingering dots not transcribed).
#   临时记号按原印本：印了才写（见 README「临时记号」）。Accidentals only where printed (editorial ones go to corrections.txt).
# 鲁特琴定弦 Lute tuning (inferred, see README): course 1–6 = G4 D4 A3 F3 C3 G2 (tenor G lute),
#   7th course (diapason, letters below the 6th line) = D2.  Fret letters a b c(r) d e f = 0–5 semitones.
# 指法谱约定 Tablature conventions in the print: letter sits on the line of its course (top line = course 1);
#   rhythm signs above the staff: plain stem = semibreve, single straight flag = minim, one loop = crotchet,
#   two loops = quaver, dot = dotted; a sign holds for the following letters until the next sign.
